purpose: Decide, without human or LLM judgement, whether a novice-intake slot's value changes the compiled artifact. A slot whose value does not change the artifact is defaulted, not asked.

signature.definition: A run signature is the sorted list of `tool_name::canonical(args)` strings for every tool call whose args object is non-empty after JSON parsing. Calls with an empty args object are excluded. A run with no qualifying call has the empty signature.

canonical_args.dict: Canonicalise every value, then emit keys sorted by Unicode code point.
canonical_args.list: If every element is a scalar (string, number, boolean, null), sort the canonical JSON text of the elements and canonicalise in that order; otherwise preserve order and canonicalise each element.
canonical_args.string: Strip leading/trailing whitespace. If the result matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:+/-]{1,32}$ (an enum-ish token), lowercase it; otherwise preserve case. Empty-after-strip is preserved as an empty string.
canonical_args.number: Round to 4 decimal places using Python round(); emit as a JSON number so trailing zeros disappear. NaN/Infinity become the strings "nan"/"inf"/"-inf".

run_policy.status_ok: The CLI exited 0 with at least one parseable assistant text or tool part, or the session-API recovery produced at least one parseable assistant text or tool part.
run_policy.status_run_error: Nonzero exit, timeout, exec failure, or no parseable assistant content after the recovery attempt. The stderr tail (<=500 chars) is retained in the transcript.
run_policy.status_incomplete: The repeat was never started because the batch wall budget was exhausted. Recorded as incomplete(budget); no signature exists.
run_policy.usable_repeat: status == ok. An empty signature is a usable signature.
run_policy.cell_with_too_few_repeats: A cell with fewer than 2 usable repeats is INCONCLUSIVE.
run_policy.retry_policy: A recorded ok repeat is never re-run. A run_error is retained as-is; it is not replaced by an extra repeat. Resume only fills repeats that were never started.

cell_rule.majority_signature: The signature shared by >=2 of the 3 repeats. With 3 repeats at most one signature can qualify.
cell_rule.stable: A cell is stable iff it has a majority signature and is not INCONCLUSIVE.
cell_rule.inconclusive_if: Fewer than 2 usable repeats, or no signature appears in >=2 repeats (3 distinct signatures).

pair_rule.comparison: For a pair of values (a, b), compare repeat index i = 0,1,2 only where both repeats have status ok.
pair_rule.comparable_requirement: At least 2 comparable repeat indices are required for the pair to be evaluable.
pair_rule.differs: The pair differs iff at least 2 comparable repeat indices have different signatures (sig_a[i] != sig_b[i]). A pair with fewer than 2 comparable indices is not evaluable and cannot contribute a difference.

precedence: INCONCLUSIVE if >=2 of the slot's 4 cells are INCONCLUSIVE.
default-worthy if all 4 cell majority signatures are identical. A cell with no majority signature cannot satisfy this; the first rule covers the >=2 case.

question-worthy if >=2 distinct majority signatures exist across the slot's 4 values AND at least one value pair differs in >=2 of 3 repeats. A cell without a majority signature contributes no signature but does not by itself block this rule unless the first rule fires.
reported_evidence: per-pair difference counts (comparable repeats) for every value pair

kill_criterion.condition: The count of default-worthy slots is >= 4 of 6.
kill_criterion.consequence: The question-slot table shrinks to private slots only: 成本价 and 仓位规模. The six tested slots (市场, 期限, 风险, 风格, 候选池, 持仓) are defaulted, not asked.
kill_criterion.not_fired_consequence: The question table keeps the question-worthy public slots plus the private slots 成本价 and 仓位规模; default-worthy public slots are defaulted; INCONCLUSIVE slots are not silently promoted to either verdict.

output_contract.machine_block: <!-- judge:begin --> ... <!-- judge:end --> containing the JSON per-slot verdicts, stability evidence and kill-criterion outcome
output_contract.tables: Every table row inside verdict.md is emitted by `python judge.py --write`; no hand-copied numbers.
output_contract.check: `python judge.py --check` recomputes every verdict from matrix.json + transcripts/ and exits nonzero on any drift (zero tolerance), including the results.json aggregates and the judge_spec.json digest recorded at run time.

pre_registration.digest_rule: sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of judge_spec.json exactly as committed. The runner records this digest in results.json meta.judge_spec_sha256 before the first run; judge.py recomputes it and refuses to judge on mismatch.
pre_registration.threshold_change_policy: Thresholds may not be loosened after seeing results. Any edit to this file voids the run and requires redoing all 72 sessions.
